_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); discount-retail signals

pit_profile.why: Walmart: 'operates retail stores in various formats around the world and is committed to saving people money so they can live better'; 'every day low prices (“EDLP”)'; 'The retail business is highly competitive' (its Wal-Mart Stores segment competes with discount, department, drug, variety and specialty stores, supermarkets, supercenter-type stores and hypermarts, 'as well as internet-based retailers and catalog businesses'); and 'General economic conditions, globally or in one or more of the markets we serve, may adversely affect our financial performance' (its own FY2008 10-K): a low-price store network whose demand follows the consumer economy by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: Walmart: 'operates retail stores in various formats around the world and is committed to saving people money so they can live better'; 'every day low prices (“EDLP”)'; 'The retail business is highly competitive' (its Wal-Mart Stores segment competes with discount, department, drug, variety and specialty stores, supermarkets, supercenter-type stores and hypermarts, 'as well as internet-based retailers and catalog businesses'); and 'General economic conditions, globally or in one or more of the markets we serve, may adversely affect our financial performance' (its own FY2008 10-K): a low-price store network whose demand follows the consumer economy by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.04x; -24% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.26; conservative 2yr +89%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY99-FY08, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +11.3%/yr (Q1 sales + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +14.4%/yr (FY99-FY08 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +23.8%/yr (best 2-yr run FY99-FY08); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: WMT (retrospective, 2008-06-27) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.04x (7.6% downside to Bear $52 / +171.8% upside to Bull $153) | Adj composite 2.56 vs market 1.30: gap +1.26 [UNDERVALUED] | -24% above the EPP floor $74 (22x FY09E $3.37) | Conservative 2-yr case: +89.1% total (+44.5%/yr) | At 16.7x FY09E the 15% hurdle price $74 sits at or below the BASE case; U.S. comps +3.3% in Q1 FY09, forward sales +10.2% (no FY09 net sales guide in numbers, Q1 FY09 net sales); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
